title: OpenAI · 定价来源更新
summary: 定价页对区域处理（数据驻留）端点的加价说明进行了更新，内容本身未变，但可能涉及链接或格式调整，强调2026年3月5日后发布模型适用10%加价。

pairs.before: Regional processing (data residency) endpoints are charged a 10% uplift for models released on or after March 5, 2026, that are eligible for data residency. See our Your data guide for supported regions and processing details. OpenAI models in Amazon Bedrock are billed through AWS and may differ from direct OpenAI pricing.
pairs.after: Regional processing (data residency) endpoints are charged a 10% uplift for models released on or after March 5, 2026, that are eligible for data residency. See our Your data guide for supported regions and processing details. OpenAI models in Amazon Bedrock are billed through AWS. Bedrock pricing in commercial regions matches OpenAI direct pricing for equivalent services.
